objective: Restore the ability for the Saim chatbot on the recipe detail page to propose and apply recipe updates from chat. Updates are held as unsaved working state with a one-level undo toast, persisted to Dexie/sync only on explicit Save, guarded against navigation loss, and always generated with the user's preferences. Source: GitHub issue pixelsailor/whats-for-dinner#46.

risk_tier.rationale: Touches AI provider boundary (ADR-007), structured output and schema contracts (ADR-008), local recipe persistence and sync write path (ADR-002, ADR-005), and new navigation/offline-sensitive UI state on the detail page.
